tagline.en: The Junipero Serra Freeway, built along a fault line on purpose
tagline.zh: 胡尼佩罗·塞拉高速：有意沿着断层线修的路

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.en: US 101 and I-680 at San Jose
start.zh: 圣何塞，与 US 101、I-680 相接

end.en: King Street at Fifth Street, San Francisco
end.zh: 旧金山，国王街与第五街交口

en: I-280 runs up the spine of the San Francisco Peninsula from San Jose to downtown San Francisco, roughly parallel to US 101 but several miles inland and several hundred feet higher. For much of its length it sits just inside the eastern rim of the rift valley of the San Andreas Fault, which is why the views are what they are: the Santa Cruz Mountains on one side, Crystal Springs Reservoir filling the valley floor, and the bay occasionally visible to the east.

It was designed to look like this. The alignment was worked out with the landscape architect Lawrence Halprin and the architect Mario Ciampi to minimise cut and fill, and the overpasses were treated as sculpture rather than infrastructure. Caltrans called it the world's most beautiful freeway in a commemorative brochure in 1973 and the dedication signs still say so. About 22 miles of it, from the Santa Clara County line to San Bruno, are an officially designated state scenic highway.
zh: I-280 沿旧金山半岛的脊线由圣何塞北上旧金山市区，大体与 US 101 平行，但偏内陆数英里、海拔高出数百英尺。它有很长一段就贴在圣安德烈亚斯断层裂谷的东缘内侧，路上的景观也因此而来：一侧是圣克鲁斯山，谷底是水晶泉水库，东侧偶尔可以望见海湾。
这副样子是设计出来的。线位是与景观建筑师劳伦斯·哈普林、建筑师马里奥·钱皮共同推敲的，尽量减少挖填；跨线桥被当作雕塑而非基础设施来处理。加州交通局在 1973 年的纪念手册中称它为「世界上最美的高速公路」，通车纪念牌上至今仍这样写。其中约 22 英里，自圣克拉拉县界至圣布鲁诺，是正式指定的州级景观公路。

en: The road was built in pieces from the 1960s. The Eugene Doran Memorial Bridge over the canyon of San Mateo Creek was completed in 1969, and the last seven miles, from Raymundo Drive in Woodside to that bridge, opened in June 1973 — the link that finally made the peninsula route continuous.

The southern end took longer and produced the best story on the route. Three flyover ramps were built at the I-280/I-680/US 101 interchange in San Jose years before the connecting freeway reached them, and stood 110 feet in the air going nowhere. In January 1976 a 1960 Chevrolet Impala appeared overnight on the topmost ramp, where no car could possibly have driven, and the city councilman Joe Colla was photographed standing next to it. The ramps opened in 1981; the interchange now carries his name.
zh: 这条路自 1960 年代起分段修建。跨圣马特奥溪峡谷的尤金·多兰纪念桥于 1969 年建成；最后七英里自伍德赛德的雷蒙多路至该桥，于 1973 年 6 月通车——正是这一段让半岛这条路终于连成一体。
南端拖得更久，也留下了全线最好的一段故事。圣何塞的 I-280/I-680/US 101 枢纽处，三条高架匝道比与之相连的高速早好几年建成，就这样在 110 英尺的高空上通向虚无。1976 年 1 月，一辆 1960 年款雪佛兰 Impala 在一夜之间出现在最高一条匝道上——那里根本不可能有车开上去——市议员乔·科拉站在车旁被拍了照。这些匝道于 1981 年开通，如今这座枢纽以他的名字命名。

timeline.en: The Doran Memorial Bridge is completed over the canyon of San Mateo Creek.
timeline.zh: 多兰纪念桥跨圣马特奥溪峡谷建成。

timeline.en: The last seven miles open in June, completing the peninsula route.
timeline.zh: 最后七英里于 6 月通车，半岛线全线贯通。

timeline.en: The San Jose flyovers finally get their connecting ramps, five years after the Impala stunt.
timeline.zh: 圣何塞的高架匝道终于接上了连接线，距那场 Impala 恶作剧已过去五年。
